title: Fail-open role→sprite mapping: #partial switch silently renders unhandled future Terminal_Role variants as a house
detail: Fail-open default: adding a future Terminal_Role variant compiles silently here and renders as a house sprite (footprint likewise, view.odin:508), eroding E9.1 distinct-shape with no signal. Project doctrine says a new role is a code change.
recommended_fix: Use an exhaustive `switch role` (handle .None/.Residential explicitly) in sprite_index_building and the footprint pick so a new enum variant is a compile error at these sites.
